no_model_called: the stand-in provider replaced Gemini; no network or API key was used
limitations: Labels are machine-drafted; only 1 of 176 primary questions is video-checked.
Evidence containing the gold passage is necessary, not sufficient, for a correct answer: answer quality is not measured here.
No playback position or attached moment is supplied, unlike a student using the app mid-lecture.
Whole-transcript mode (short lectures) makes evidence_hit trivially 1 for those lectures; strata by mode make this visible.
A passage containing a gold cue is counted relevant even when the cue is a minor part of it.
